triage_candidates.statement: Pre-existing simplification debt surfaced by --paths during G2: src/evo_predictor/gold_cycle/config.py _parse_and_validate (~134 lines) and src/evo_predictor/run.py _build_parser (~195 lines) + cmd_train_latent_power_module (124 lines) exceed the <100 function-line limit. Plan a focused split. Not caused by issue 356; grandfathered by --baseline only as part of broader legacy debt.

Pre-existing simplification debt: scripts/run_sampled_runtime_comparison.py run_comparison is 134 lines (>100 limit), pre-existing (was 135 pre-G5). Extract the backtest execution block into a helper. Not caused by issue 356.

Latent-power training is not bit-reproducible run-to-run on torch 2.10 CPU (py3.14/Win) even single-thread + same-seed + fixed PYTHONHASHSEED (~3e-4 weight drift; rank metrics swing O(0.1-0.3)). Orthogonal to run_jobs/parallelism, but means gold-cycle committed artifacts are not bit-stable across reruns in general. Investigate torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True) + deterministic reductions + thread pinning; assess training-speed cost. Human approved filing as a separate issue (2026-06-03).
